name: kissmypost
description: Reddit analytics and audience research for AI assistants: find subreddits for a topic, see who is in them, the best time to post, posting rules and Reddit brand mentions. KissMyPost works as a subreddit finder and Reddit marketing tool: subreddit growth and audience stats, similar subreddits, trending topics, Reddit post and mention search, and threads worth a reply. 17 read-only tools. Free API key at kissmypost.com/mcp. Not affiliated with Reddit, Inc.
